records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total revenue decreased by $17.9 million, or 20.7%, to $68.4 million from $86.3 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We have existing relationships with all major OEMs or their tier 1 suppliers, and while our customer contracts vary, they generally represent multi-year engagements, giving us some level of visibility into future revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As of March 31, 2023, our net working capital, excluding deferred revenue and deferred costs, was $134.0 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating margin decreased 37.4 percentage points to negative 30.1% from 7.3%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities was $6.6 million, a net change of $5.0 million from cash provided by operating activities of $1.6 million.
